rationale: The assistant correctly ordered simple checks first (socket test, consumer unit), then used the customer's confirmed results to conclude an internal power-supply fault, naming the mains filter and board PSU as 'leading possibilities' without false certainty, and explicitly told him not to open it and to keep it unplugged. No facts were invented and no part was pushed. Weaknesses: it never asked for the model number, age, or warranty status (an important unknown, and Candy/Haier service was not mentioned by name), and it escalated after only two turns without exploring the door interlock or asking about burning smells/visible damage as a question rather than a caveat.
